meta.name: Saffron
meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Thin-to-moderate, and geographically narrow: the only cleanly verifiable 2025+ foreign buy-side demand on the public web is a handful of France/Spain buy requests on EspaceAgro (one, ref 699801, explicitly naming Iranian saffron) — genuine but low-volume. The higher-volume-looking 'leads' on TradeKey/ExportHub/go4WorldBusiness are mostly gated, anonymized (bare first names), recycled from 2018-2021, or auto-generated lead-farm/SEO content with no reachable contacts, and do not hold up under scrutiny.
